## Education

**PhD, Fisheries, Wildlife, and Conservation Sciences** — Oregon State University,
Corvallis, Oregon. Expected 2027. Advisor: Dr. Ivan Arismendi.
Research focus: trophic interactions between non-native Smallmouth Bass and crayfish
in Oregon river systems.

**MEd, Gifted Education** *(Summa Cum Laude)* — Flinders University, Adelaide,
Australia, 2019–2021.
Thesis: a statistical study of the effects of electronic games on gifted students.

**BEd, Biology** — King Khalid University, Abha, Saudi Arabia, 1994–1998.
Project: survey of significant plant species of the Tihama and Asir regions.

## Research and professional experience

**Graduate Researcher** — Oregon State University, Corvallis, Oregon. Present.
Field and experimental research on freshwater invasions and predator–prey dynamics;
statistical analysis in R and spatial modeling of invasive species distributions;
water quality and trophic analysis supporting conservation in the Willamette system.

**Lecturer and Trainer, Environmental Sustainability** — Principles of Environmental
Sustainability Program, Qunfudhah, Saudi Arabia. May 2012 – September 2017.
Trained conservation professionals and park rangers in ecological assessment and
wildlife management; delivered technical workshops on water quality monitoring;
contributed to conservation work in the Wadi Hali region.

**Biology Teacher** — Ministry of Education, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Since January 1999.
Designed and taught inquiry-based biology curricula; integrated data analysis and
spatial tools into classroom science; led development of an environmental science
curriculum adopted by five regional schools; mentored students to regional and
national science fair recognition.

## Skills

**Quantitative.** R and RStudio, ecological modeling, mixed models, spatial stream
network modeling, species distribution modeling, GIS (ArcGIS Pro), SPSS,
experimental design.

**Laboratory and field.** Stable isotope analysis, diet analysis, mesocosm design
and operation, water quality measurement (pH, dissolved oxygen, conductivity,
nitrates), taxonomy and species identification, microscopy, dissection and
anatomical analysis, temperature logger deployment.

**Reproducibility.** Quarto, Git and GitHub, Zotero with Better BibTeX.

**Teaching.** Curriculum development, inquiry-based science teaching, STEM
education, differentiated instruction, e-learning and virtual labs, scientific
mentoring.

**Languages.** Arabic (native), English (fluent).
